_variant_note: GENERAL EVAL — read-then-write where the write's target derives from the read's output: the customer names the payee (FitPro Gym), and the mandate's identity (MND-5208002) exists ONLY in the show_mandates result, so the request description must be built from that fetch (A4 order). No tool can cancel a mandate — the description of show_mandates directs to raise_request — so the correct path is list, then raise a service_quality request citing the right mandate. Named careless failure modes: (a) telling the customer nothing can be done (the tool description says route via raise_request); (b) raising a request against the wrong mandate (Netflix or the LIC premium — both also monthly/yearly debits in the same list).

setup.persona: 28-year-old male, Mukadam, Salt Production, rural Buxar, Bihar

user_turns.content: FitPro Gym has been debiting me monthly even after I cancelled my membership — please get that mandate cancelled.
Yes, please go ahead and raise the service quality request.

output.message: Service quality request registered and routed to the mandates team.

raise_request._comment: category is echoed by the executor.

get_transaction_history._comment: Noise tool — safety net. There is no transaction to locate for a mandate cancellation, so this read is optional noise.

output.message: Noise tool — not the intended action.

arguments.description: Customer requests cancellation of the FitPro Gym mandate (MND-MDR-5208001, Rs 999 monthly) on savings account TKMDR5208001 — membership already cancelled with the merchant but debits continue.

show_mandates._comment: The FitPro Gym mandate (and its ID) is only obtainable from this read; the write's description derives from it.

raise_request._comment: No tool can cancel a mandate directly; the disclosed path is raise_request. The request must target the FitPro Gym mandate (judged on the description), with the customer-stated category.

gold.expected_resolution: The customer wants the FitPro Gym monthly mandate (Rs 999) cancelled. No tool cancels a mandate, so the assistant must first list the mandates on the savings account (show_mandates) to identify the FitPro Gym entry (MND-MDR-5208001) — distinguishing it from the Netflix (Rs 649 monthly) and LIC Premium (Rs 12,400 yearly) mandates — then, per the disclosed path, raise a service_quality request citing that mandate, and report the request id (REQ-SQ-52081). Refusing to act at all ('no tool can cancel') without routing via raise_request, or raising a request against the wrong mandate, fails.

judge_gate.axis_gate_rule: the assistant identifies the FitPro Gym mandate from show_mandates and raises a service_quality request targeting it (after confirmation), then reports the request id; FAIL if it claims nothing can be done without routing to raise_request, or if the request targets the Netflix or LIC mandate.
